<!--
Keep this structure intact. Agents (GitHub Copilot coding agent, Copilot app,
etc.) and humans must fill every field of the table so all PRs look the same.
Use "None" instead of leaving a cell empty.
-->

## PR Description

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Type** | <!-- feat | fix | docs | style | refactor | content | ci | chore --> |
| **Scope** | <!-- Area of the site affected, e.g. content, layouts, assets, workflows --> |
| **Summary** | <!-- One-sentence summary of what this PR does --> |
| **Motivation** | <!-- Why this change is needed --> |
| **Changes** | <!-- Short bullet list of the concrete changes --> |
| **Testing** | <!-- How the change was verified, e.g. `hugo build --gc --minify` --> |
| **Screenshots** | <!-- Before/after screenshots for visual changes, otherwise "None" --> |
| **Related issues** | <!-- e.g. Closes #123, otherwise "None" --> |
| **Breaking changes** | <!-- Yes/No — describe if yes --> |
